commands.label: Run the native output as a hidden Windows console process

isolation: CREATE_NO_WINDOW, process-local Windows error-dialog suppression and genuine console executables.
toolchain: Official Ecere SDK 0.44.15 with its native Windows console compiler
reproduction_command: epj2make hello.epj; mingw32-make -f hello.Makefile; run the generated Windows console application
semantic_scope: The publisher compiler compiled the unchanged eC program using a disposable project fixture. The native Windows console executable emitted the exact greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
